Needs changes before merge: the required reporter hand-test has no confirmation.

The code review found no code blocker. The complete diff preserves explicit model names, the fallback modes, and the endpoint restrictions. Both linked UI screenshots load and show the changed field and library link. No screenshot or review artifact was added to the PR branch.

## Requested before merge

1. **PR body, reporter hand-test section; issue #3782, User validation:** Add the reporter's desktop hand-test result on this PR. The issue requires this confirmation before merge. The body says that it is still pending. Record the tested build and the result of the local preset checklist. Keep the PR a draft until the reporter confirms the result. The loopback tests and UI screenshots do not supply this desktop confirmation.

## Local results

PR head: `fd3a9a130137221081b9b5e204964a08e962477a`.
Upstream main: `db3bb1f7f3c47cf3561a8e9534f4f2cde260cba8`.
Trial merge: `d6124e70070247d0fdcfbc9c1b3b61da91d05db8`.
The trial merge's first parent is the PR head. All commands ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-3799`. No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 14 steps passed; 1,898 tests passed; 8 ignored; no failed step |
| App suites | `lib`: 303 passed; `ai_http`: 10 passed; `ai_http_review`: 5 passed |
| UI suites | `lib`: 1,542 passed, 8 ignored; `boundary`: 3; `boundary_picks`: 7; `contour_dxf_sketch`: 2; `sinker_setup`: 2; `tap_hand`: 3; `theme_example`: 3; `theme_files`: 17; `waterjet_tool`: 1. All passed. |
| `cargo clippy -j32 -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |
| `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` | 62 steps passed; 0 failed; 0 stalled; 33.4 minutes |
| `cargo xtask gate light` | 6 steps passed; all 11 light tests passed |

The heavy gate checked two known-fail tests for open issues #1950 and #2849. Both failed at their registered assertion and message, as required. The gate marked both checks `ok`, with `known fail, red as expected`. These are expected negative checks, not new test failures.

Heavy lanes green on `fd3a9a130137221081b9b5e204964a08e962477a`: 62 steps, 0 failed. Base: `db3bb1f7f3c47cf3561a8e9534f4f2cde260cba8`. Local trial merge and commands are listed above.

## Extra suites run

`cargo xtask gate batch --only "app suites: example_catalog"`: passed, 39 tests passed and 4 ignored.
No fixture or import code changed. The extra STEP and machining mesh suites do not apply.

## Scope and limits

This is not a safety-tier change. It changes no posted G-code, collision check, gouge check, stock simulation, or geometry algorithm. Mutations: not run; this review made no code changes. Goldens moved: none. No `.nc`, `.cl`, or example catalog program changed.

The model IDs agree with the official [Anthropic catalog](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/overview), [OpenAI model page](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-6.2-sol), and [Gemini model page](https://aistudio.google.com/docs/models/gemini-4-hydrogen). The discovery request agrees with the [Ollama model list API](https://docs.ollama.com/api/tags).

Live cloud calls, a real Ollama runtime, macOS, and release-only pixel snapshots were not exercised. The worktree and branch remain in place to retain the build cache.

The label is `needs-rework` because the required reporter confirmation is absent. A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: No finding is resolved in this round.

The latest review requests the reporter's desktop hand-test result, the tested build, and the local preset checklist results.

The latest review records a green quick gate, clippy, 62 heavy steps, and the example catalog suite on this head.

The PR remains a draft. The warm worktree `.claude/worktrees/fix-3799` remains in place.
Please re-review after the reporter posts the tested build and desktop checklist results on this PR.

Review note (reporter-side, 2026-11-23): the no-model message suggests `ollama pull qwen3:8b`. Our own local-model MCP benchmark (12 models, 20 CamCraft tasks, 2026-11-22) scored qwen3:8b 9/20; it cannot change a project reliably. The stronger installed-size options were qwen3.6 (13/20), qwen3.8 (15/20) and ornith-1.5:35b (16/20). Suggest naming one of those, or a short list, until #3789's recommendations exist. This is not a blocker for the hand-test.

Reporter hand-test (2026-11-23, combined with #3798): see https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/3798 finding 1. With a CLOUD provider selected and the Model field empty, the panel shows this PR's local hint "Automatic: installed tool-capable model", and Test fails. An empty cloud Model must use the cloud table default (`claude-sonnet-5-5` for Anthropic) and show it. The automatic selection and its hint apply to local providers only. NOT OK yet.

**Reporter hand-test, Ollama (2026-11-23, combined build):** with "Offline local (Ollama)" and an empty Model, the panel kept saying **"Ollama not running at http://localhost:11434/v1 - start Ollama and check the model"**, even after `ollama serve` (0.40.16) was running. From the same Mac at that moment, `curl` returns 200 from `http://localhost:11434/api/version`, `http://127.0.0.1:11434` and `http://[::1]:11434`, and `/v1/models` lists the installed models (phi4-mini, llama3.1:8b, qwen3:8b, qwen3:4b, qwen3.6, qwen3.8, ornith-1.5:35b, nemotron-3.5-super ...). So the server was up, and the status was wrong or stale. Please check:
1. Is readiness re-checked after the server starts (on Test, on provider re-select, or on a timer)? A status from before `ollama serve` must not persist.
2. Does the automatic selection fail (no model judged tool-capable, a `/api/show` timeout across about 30 models, or an error parsing a model's capabilities) and then report it as "not running"? Each cause needs its own message: server unreachable vs. no tool-capable model installed vs. probe failed for <model>.
3. The probe over many installed models must be bounded in time and must say which model it picked.
Gemini (Cloud) with `gemini-4-hydrogen`: Test passed and one chat reply came back. One Send got `HTTP 503: model experiencing high demand`; that is a provider-side transient and is shown clearly.

Reporter hand-test, Ollama follow-up (2026-11-23): with Model **`qwen3.8:latest` typed explicitly**, the status reads "Ready (local model qwen3.8:latest)" and "hi" gets a correct reply after about 10-20 s (model load). So the local path works with an explicit model, and the empty-model / automatic path is the broken part (see the previous comment).
Two more findings:
1. **Test does nothing visible for Ollama.** No "Testing...", no "Test passed", no failure. Give it the same result line as the cloud providers (passed / failed with the reason), and a "Testing..." state while it runs. A first-load model can take tens of seconds.
2. **Show progress during a slow first reply.** Say "Loading model qwen3.8:latest..." or show elapsed seconds, so the user does not think it hung.
Also confirms #3785 item 9: the conversation carried over from the Gemini session into the Ollama one (old "hi"/503 turns still shown and sent).

Reporter request (2026-11-23), for the "Offline local (Ollama)" text:
- **Say plainly who starts the server.** Today CamCraft does not start Ollama: the user must open the Ollama app (menu bar) or run `ollama serve`. The panel must state that in one line next to the status, for example "CamCraft connects to Ollama at http://localhost:11434. Start the Ollama app (or run `ollama serve`) first." It must not suggest that CamCraft starts it. If the feature below lands, the line changes to say that CamCraft starts it.
- In the reporter's test, a second `ollama serve` in Terminal was started although the Ollama app was already running. The text should say: "If the Ollama app is in your menu bar, the server is already running."

Addressed:

- Empty cloud Model: the field displays the shared provider default. Requests use that default. The automatic-selection hint applies only to local providers. Pinned by `empty_cloud_model_shows_table_default_and_local_hint_stays_local` and `empty_cloud_request_uses_table_default_without_local_discovery`.
- Install guidance: the message suggests `ollama pull ornith-1.5:35b`. The reporter benchmark scored this model 16/20. Pinned by `ollama_defaults_without_tool_models_give_install_guidance`.

Mutation proof: Each pin failed when its fix was reverted. Each pin passed after the fix was restored.
Validation: Quick gate: 14 steps passed, 1,900 tests passed, 8 ignored. Clippy passed. The example catalog suite passed: 39 tests passed, 4 ignored.
New head: `f172590ec1138b2f6157c77e7504e42dd7fc6608`.

The PR remains a draft. The reporter must confirm the desktop result on this head.
Please re-review these fixes.
